KeyAura is a professional Android custom keyboard featuring stunning radial color animations, Roman Urdu to Urdu transliteration, and a sleek dark UI designed for the ultimate typing experience.

Built with passion for users who want both style and functionality in their daily typing.

Features:
• Multi-color radial animations
• Roman Urdu to Urdu typing
• Smart Enter key
• Auto-return to letters
• Customizable settings
• Landscape support

Developed by OKLabs
We\'d love to hear from you! Reach out to us via email or social media.

Last updated: July 2026

OKLabs ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use KeyAura.

1. Information We Collect
- Keyboard input: We do not store or transmit any text you type. All processing happens locally on your device.
- Usage data: We may collect anonymous usage statistics to improve the app, but only if you opt in.
- No personal information is collected without your explicit consent.

2. Permissions
- RECORD_AUDIO: Used only for speech-to-text functionality. Audio is processed locally and never stored.
- VIBRATE: Used for haptic feedback.
- INTERNET: Used for displaying ads (future) and downloading resources.

3. Third-Party Services
We may use third-party services (e.g., AdMob/AppLovin) for advertising. These services have their own privacy policies.

4. Data Security
We take reasonable measures to protect your data, but no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

5. Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

6. Contact Us
If you have any questions, please contact us at: a.rehmanmazher11@gmail.com
